proposed_decisions: Cross-packet dependency: this body cites w02b-p15-043 and w02b-p15-042 labels (list in the research note). Keep them stable or retarget.

Multiplier notation follows def:p15-w02b-p15-043-partition (lambda, Jaynes's sign e^{-lambda.f}); lambda_s in thm:p15-w02b-p15-044-cubes indexes the reference measure, so lambda_0 there is the multiplier for nu_0 (equal to 0), not Jaynes's normalization constant lambda_0 = ln Z. Scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-044-cubes; lead may rename to kappa_s if the clash is judged confusing.
nu_s (s=0,1,2) on (0,1] here vs nu_n(dx)=x^n dx on (0,infty) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-043-power-family: same glyph pattern, different spaces; both scoped to their sections.

Shannon reprint keys: 040 and 041 intakes define Shannon1948MathematicalTheory, 042 uses ShannonMTC1948Reprint for the same held reprint; finalizer should keep one. This packet no longer cites Shannon.
